scripts.build: npm run build:circuits && npm run build:program
scripts.build:circuits: npm run build:deposit && npm run build:withdraw
scripts.build:deposit: xark --version | grep -q '^xark 0\.3\.' || { echo 'needs xark 0.3: see ../RUNBOOK.md' >&2; exit 1; }; xark build circuits/deposit && xark setup circuits/deposit --r1cs-form reduced && (cd circuits/deposit && cargo run -q --release --example demo) && xark export circuits/deposit --crate-name shielded-pool-deposit-xark-verifier && xark client circuits/deposit --out client/
scripts.build:withdraw: xark --version | grep -q '^xark 0\.3\.' || { echo 'needs xark 0.3: see ../RUNBOOK.md' >&2; exit 1; }; xark build circuits/withdraw && xark setup circuits/withdraw --r1cs-form reduced && (cd circuits/withdraw && cargo run -q --release --example demo) && xark export circuits/withdraw --crate-name shielded-pool-withdraw-xark-verifier && xark client circuits/withdraw --out client/
scripts.test:circuit: (cd circuits/pool && cargo test --release) && xark test circuits/deposit && xark test circuits/withdraw && cd program && cargo test -q --release
scripts.fmt:check: for m in $(git ls-files '*Cargo.toml'); do cargo fmt --check --manifest-path $m || exit 1; done
scripts.clippy: for m in $(git ls-files '*Cargo.toml'); do cargo clippy --manifest-path $m --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings || exit 1; done
scripts.check:clients: git diff --exit-code -- client/ && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- client/)"
